name: Marina Bay Street Circuit
blurb: Marina Bay Street Circuit: 4.940 km and 19 turns through the streets around Marina Bay, host of the Singapore Grand Prix, the sport's original night race.

facts.Signature sections: The Raffles Boulevard run, the Stamford Road corner at Turn 9, the Esplanade Drive blast, the Bayfront Avenue stretch to the Turn 18 and 19 chicane
facts.Venue data: The circuit was traced from the official 2025 Singapore Grand Prix map onto OpenStreetMap roads (lap 4.94 km vs 4.940 official); the stretch beside the Singapore Flyer is not in OpenStreetMap, so it follows the map. Gates 1 to 8, named grandstands, MRT stations, first aid, restrooms and information points come from that map; positions are approximate. Hospitality lounges, food stands and merchandise are not placed. Layouts change each year: check the current map.
